ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with a predominance of high-intensity (white) pixels over low-intensity (black) pixels, roughly in a 70:30 ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Significant central low-intensity (black) region extending from the base/notch into the proximal lower lobes. A continuous low-intensity boundary follows the trailing edge of both lobes. Fine-scale low-intensity mottling is visible within the interior high-intensity regions, specifically on the lower-right and mid-left lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with an internal angle of approximately 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing edges of both lobes, characterized by irregular peaks and valleys with a pixel-amplitude variation of approximately 4-8 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory from the distal tips curving medially toward the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, discrete low-intensity circular clusters detected on the right lobe interior and bottom-left interior fluke surfaces.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of several faint, diagonal linear pixel disruptions on the upper-middle region of the left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Highly irregular and jagged trailing edge topography suggests cumulative acquired physical trauma or tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive bifurcated shape of the central dark pigmentation patch resembling an inverted butterfly pattern.
